verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Square has developer docs, SDKs, and a sandbox for testing (square-docs-13), but nothing describes an interactive API reference with runnable/try-it examples embedded in the docs; probes even show no discoverable OpenAPI spec (square-probe-3) that would typically power such a console. missing for 10: evidence of an interactive 'try it out' console, embedded runnable code samples in the reference docs, or OpenAPI-driven explorer UI.
